svg.title: EAC100m exploratory section-core spans
svg.desc: Exploratory EAC100m section-normal component spans for all3770 source dates. The primary half-peak case resolves2883dates and leaves887unresolved, including629missing dates. Monthly denominators and fixed source examples retain domain failures, excluded bottom cells and supplied-magnitude sensitivity. These are section distances, not physical current widths or annual extrema.
